label: ProposeWorkspace
prompt: Use a polished but restrained offer layout with readable customer context and aligned itemized currency amounts. Distinguish editable drafts, frozen revisions, recipient decisions, and booking follow-up outcomes; keep exact revision details prominent during review. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
